# s294 — Relay board shows nested runs as a tree with rounds, freshness and recent results

The relay board draws each run as a tree from the steps the ledger already records: the slice's title, the orchestrator and the roles under it, rounds and gate failures, how long since the run was last heard from, and recently ended runs. It also fixes the bug that left every role "waiting" in a nested run.

**Findings:** nested-relay trial 2026-10-15: board shows roles waiting while relay-run list shows them running under the orchestrator step; owner widened it to a board redesign the same day · **Size:** M · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The owner's screenshots during the nested-relay trial on 2026-10-15 showed run `run-20261015-155856-07d1` (s279) with `[ ] implementer waiting`, `[ ] reviewer waiting`, `[ ] gate waiting` and `other: orchestrator`. At the same time `slicer relay-run list` showed step 2, the implementer, started with parent 1. `_latest_by_role` (`src/slicer/tui.py:1187`) skips every step that has a parent. The rule was meant for subagents that a role spawns, but `slicer ai relay` (`## Order`) tells a subagent to add `--parent STEP`, and in a nested relay every role step is a child of the orchestrator step. The lane therefore never moves.

The owner then asked for a prettier board with more and better information, and chose (2026-10-15) to widen this slice in v1.11 to: the title, a tree, glyphs and colors; rounds and gate history; recently ended runs; and a freshness and stale warning. Today the lane header repeats the id (`s279 active 12m56s s279`), each role row shows only its latest step, the orchestrator is pushed to `other:`, ended runs are filtered out (`tui.py:803`, so s290's pass vanished as soon as it ended), and nothing warns before a run goes stale at `relayrun.STALE_AFTER` (30 minutes).

## Files

Uses only data the ledger and the roadmap already hold. The `relay-run` CLI and the ledger format do not change.

- `src/slicer/tui.py`, `board_lines` and its helpers:
  - **Nested lane (the bug).** A step fills a role row when it has no parent or its parent is an `orchestrator` step of the same run. A step whose parent is any other role is that role's subagent, as now.
  - **Header.** `<glyph> <items>  <title>  <state/outcome>  <elapsed>`, with the title of the first item looked up from the loaded roadmap and cut with `_ellipsis`. The worktree appears only when its name differs from the item id. A second line: `orchestrator <model>/<effort>` when there is an orchestrator step, `wt <name>` when it differs, and `last heard <N> ago` from the run's `updated_at`.
  - **Glyphs and colors.** Use the existing style roles: active `●` (`heading`), pass `✓` (`done`), fail `✗` (`error`), stopped or stale `~` (`dim`). Step markers stay as they are: the spinner, `+`, `!` and `~`.
  - **Pipeline line.** Each finished role is drawn as done, the running role in brackets as now, and the rest dim. At the right edge, `round N`, where N is the number of implementer steps that fill the lane.
  - **Tree.** The orchestrator, when present, is the root row: `└ orchestrator <model>/<effort> <marker> <elapsed>`. The role rows sit under it with `├`/`└`. Without an orchestrator the rows keep today's flat layout. The `other:` line remains only for roles outside the pipeline and orchestrator.
  - **Rounds and gate history.** A role row shows `×N` when the role has more than one lane step. A gate step that failed adds a line under the gate: `✗ gate FAIL → implementer round N+1`, with the task text cut to fit.
  - **Freshness.** `last heard` uses the `dim` role normally, `started` (warning) when the gap passes half of `relayrun.STALE_AFTER`, and `error` once the run is stale.
  - **Recent ended runs.** `_load_board` keeps runs that ended within the last hour (a named constant), after the active ones, newest first. Each is one dimmed line: `<glyph> <items>  <title>  <outcome>  <elapsed>  ended <N> ago`, then `impl N · review N · gate N` from its step counts.
  - Everything stays within `width` through `_fit` / `_ellipsis` and `tui_style.cell_width`. The board stays read-only.
- `docs/tui.md`: update the relay board section and its example lane to match.
- `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`: Fixed (nested lane) and Changed (board).
- `tests/test_tui.py`, next to the `test_BoardLines_*` tests. Update any existing board test whose expected text changes, and keep its intent.

- `test_LoadBoard_KeepsRecentlyEndedRuns`: a run ended 10 minutes ago is kept as one summary line with its outcome and counts. A run ended 2 hours ago is dropped.
- `test_BoardLines_NarrowWidth_NoLineExceedsWidth`: at widths 40 and 80, every line fits.
